title: Thermal Protector Trip
shortDescription: Samsung disposal has tripped its thermal overload.
fullDescription:
The thermal protector opens when motor temperature exceeds its rating. This happens during extended use or when jammed. Wait 10-15 minutes for the unit to cool before pressing the reset button.

Repeated trips indicate a deeper mechanical or electrical issue.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press the red reset button on the disposal underside.

whenToCallPro: If repeated tripping cannot be traced to a jam.

faq.q: Why does it trip after short use?
faq.a: A partial jam is likely stressing the motor; inspect the chamber.

title: Blockage Detected
fullDescription:
BL (Blockage) indicates Samsung's electronic control detected stalled motor current. The disposal shuts down to prevent damage.

Remove the obstruction and cycle power to clear.

fixSteps.title: Manual rotation
fixSteps.instruction: Insert hex key in the bottom port and rotate to free.

whenToCallPro: If the impeller still will not spin after clearing.

faq.a: Only on models with electronic current sensing.

title: Water Leak Detected
shortDescription: Built-in leak sensor detected water under the disposal.
fullDescription:
Smart Samsung disposals include a leak sensor that cuts power when moisture is detected. Inspect mounting flange, discharge pipe, and dishwasher inlet.

Dry thoroughly and the unit reactivates.

fixSteps.title: Dry area
fixSteps.instruction: Thoroughly dry all surfaces with a towel.

fixSteps.title: Locate leak
fixSteps.instruction: Run water and inspect every joint.

whenToCallPro: If the disposal body itself leaks.

faq.a: Not recommended - water detection prevents larger damage.

title: Communication Error (Smart Model)
fullDescription:
CE indicates the disposal's smart module cannot communicate with the Samsung SmartThings app or router. Grinding still works but usage stats do not update.

Restart router and re-pair in the app.

fixSteps.title: Restart router
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle the router and wait 2 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Remove device in SmartThings and add again.

title: Abnormal Noise Detected
shortDescription: Built-in acoustic sensor flags excessive noise.
fullDescription:
Premium Samsung disposals include a vibration or acoustic sensor. Abnormal rattling or scraping triggers NS.

Remove any foreign object from the chamber.

fixSteps.title: Inspect chamber
fixSteps.instruction: Flashlight to locate and tongs to remove object.

whenToCallPro: If noise persists after removing obstruction.

faq.a: Only via app, but this defeats protective function.

title: Filter Clean Reminder
shortDescription: Splash guard or batch feed filter due for cleaning.
fullDescription:
Select Samsung models track usage hours and remind the user to clean the removable splash guard. Food residue on the splash guard can cause odors.

Remove and clean with warm soapy water.

fixSteps.title: Remove splash guard
fixSteps.instruction: Pull out the rubber splash guard.

fixSteps.title: Clean
fixSteps.instruction: Wash with warm soapy water and a brush.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the reset button on the disposal for 3 seconds.

title: Power Supply Error
fullDescription:
PW indicates the disposal's smart controller detected voltage outside 108-132V range. This can damage electronics.

Check the outlet voltage and reset.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify 120V at the outlet.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cord
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cord damage or loose connections.

whenToCallPro: If voltage at outlet is abnormal - electrical issue.

faq.q: Can I use a surge protector?
faq.a: Yes, a quality surge protector is recommended.

title: Odor Alert
shortDescription: Long idle period detected - clean to prevent odor.
fullDescription:
Samsung smart disposals track run frequency. If the unit has not run for days, OD appears to remind the user to run ice and citrus peels to clean.

This is a maintenance reminder, not a fault.

fixSteps.title: Ice and citrus
fixSteps.instruction: Run ice cubes and lemon peel to scour and freshen.

videoSearchQuery: garbage disposal odor ice lemon clean

faq.a: Avoid bleach - use baking soda and vinegar instead.
